HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
DOE v. HARBOR LABS, INC. Protective Order, August 15, 2013, by the Hon. Ann Smith
A party or a third party may mark material CONFIDENTIAL if it holds pricing,
customer or personnel information.
CONFIDENTIAL material may be read only by counsel of record, the parties' experts
who sign Exhibit A, and the court.
CONFIDENTIAL material may not be entered into any generative AI tool or other
outside service.
Within 60 days after the case ends, each recipient returns or destroys CONFIDENTIAL
material and says so in writing.
